summary: Implemented rich.progress open and wrap_file (module-level and Progress methods) with a private byte-counting reader and context wrapper, in rich/progress.py. Added 27 tests in tests/test_progress.py, a "Reading from a file" and "Reading from a file-like object" section in docs/source/progress.rst, and a CHANGELOG.md entry linking PR 1759. The diff is additive only (865 insertions, 0 deletions). Nothing is committed. Tests, mypy, and repository code were not run, per instructions, so verification was by reading only. Open risks: the strict-mypy unused-ignore status of the return-value/type-var suppression in module-level open, and the readinto rejected-buffer test, which has not been executed.
